query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.primaryDomain, c.websiteUrl
FROM companies c 
WHERE c.searchId IN (1500002, 1500003) 
  AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT companyId FROM contacts)
LIMIT 20;
